recent.text: Thank you very much. Mr. President, on -- on this bill. I think we just have to be careful when we start, in a sense, creating a situation where there can be no action on the part of individuals. In this particular case we're talking about crime victims or we're talking about good samaritans who intervene in an actual crime. There's certainly been a number of situations where people intervened…

recent.text: Actually, Senator, I like this bill, and I want to vote for it. I just wanted to ask you if the whole difference between our criminal and our civil system is actually the standard of proof. Don't you think that sometimes the -- there could be an action that could be taken that certainly would not incur any criminal liability but, because of the different standard of proof being the preponderance…

recent.text: Mr. President, would Senator Skelos yield for a question?
